attributes.description: Detail view of a single GKE namespace: CPU and memory used against requests and limits, PVC fill, pod phase mix, and the pods and workloads in the namespace. Open it from a namespace or workload row on [GCP OTel] GKE Overview or [GCP OTel] GKE Cluster Detail.

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "< Overview"
ROW `Open` = "< Overview"

embeddableConfig.description: Returns to [GCP OTel] GKE Overview in the same tab, keeping the current time range.
Name of the namespace selected by the current filters, with the cluster it belongs to.
esql_query: FROM metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container" | STATS last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY namespace = COALESCE(resource.attributes.namespace_name, resource.attributes.namespace), cluster = COALESCE(resource.attributes.cluster_name, resource.attributes.cluster) | SORT last_seen DESC | KEEP namespace, cluster | LIMIT 1
embeddableConfig.template:
{% if rows.size == 0 %}
No namespace matches the current filters.
{% else %} {% for row in rows %}
{{ row["namespace"].value }}
{{ row["cluster"].value }}
{% endfor %} {% endif %}

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover"
ROW `Open` = "View metrics in Discover"

embeddableConfig.description: Opens this namespace's metric documents in Discover in the same tab, with the current filters and time range.

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container"
| STATS used = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time`)), lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/limit_cores`)) BY resource.attributes.pod_name, resource.attributes.container_name
| WHERE lim > 0
| STATS cpu_limit_utilization_pct = 100 * SUM(used) / SUM(lim)

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container"
| STATS used = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time`)), lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/limit_cores`)) BY resource.attributes.pod_name, resource.attributes.container_name
| WHERE lim > 0
| STATS cpu_limit_utilization_pct = 100 * SUM(used) / SUM(lim)

embeddableConfig.description: CPU in use over CPU limits for the namespace's containers that have a limit (`container/cpu/core_usage_time` rate over `container/cpu/limit_cores`), over the selected range. Green below 70%, amber from 70%, red from 90%. Empty when no container has a CPU limit.
embeddableConfig.title: CPU limit utilization %

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container"
| STATS used = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time`)),
        req = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/request_cores`)),
        lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/limit_cores`))
    BY resource.attributes.pod_name, resource.attributes.container_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS cpu_used_cores = SUM(used), cpu_requested_cores = SUM(req), cpu_limit_cores = SUM(CASE(lim > 0, lim, NULL)) BY bucket
| SORT bucket ASC

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container"
| STATS used = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time`)),
        req = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/request_cores`)),
        lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/limit_cores`))
    BY resource.attributes.pod_name, resource.attributes.container_name, bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS cpu_used_cores = SUM(used), cpu_requested_cores = SUM(req), cpu_limit_cores = SUM(CASE(lim > 0, lim, NULL)) BY bucket
| SORT bucket ASC

embeddableConfig.description: CPU cores used by the namespace's containers (`container/cpu/core_usage_time` rate), their requests (`container/cpu/request_cores`) and the sum of the limits that are set (`container/cpu/limit_cores`), per time bucket.
embeddableConfig.title: CPU used vs requests and limits

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container" AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/used_bytes`)), lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/limit_bytes`)) BY resource.attributes.pod_name, resource.attributes.container_name
| WHERE lim > 0
| STATS memory_limit_utilization_pct = 100 * TO_DOUBLE(SUM(used)) / SUM(lim)

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container" AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS used = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/used_bytes`)), lim = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/limit_bytes`)) BY resource.attributes.pod_name, resource.attributes.container_name
| WHERE lim > 0
| STATS memory_limit_utilization_pct = 100 * TO_DOUBLE(SUM(used)) / SUM(lim)

embeddableConfig.description: Non-evictable memory in use over memory limits for the namespace's containers that have a limit (`container/memory/used_bytes` over `container/memory/limit_bytes`). Green below 70%, amber from 70%, red from 90%. A container is killed when it passes its memory limit.
embeddableConfig.title: Memory limit utilization %

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_container" AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)

| STATS memory_used_gib = SUM(used) / 1073741824.0, memory_requested_gib = SUM(req) / 1073741824.0, memory_limit_gib = SUM(CASE(lim > 0, lim, NULL)) / 1073741824.0 BY bucket
| SORT bucket ASC

query.esql:

| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "k8s_pod" AND attributes.persistentvolumeclaim_name IS NOT NULL

| STATS fullest_pvc_pct = MAX(util) * 100

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default

    BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
| EVAL pvc_used_gib = pvc_used_bytes/1073741824.0, pvc_capacity_gib = pvc_capacity_bytes/1073741824.0
| SORT bucket ASC
| KEEP bucket, pvc_used_gib, pvc_capacity_gib

    BY bucket = TBUCKET(75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)

embeddableConfig.description: Used bytes against capacity summed over the PersistentVolumeClaim volumes of the namespace's pods (`pod/volume/used_bytes` and `pod/volume/total_bytes`), in GiB per time bucket. Other volume types are left out.

TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type == "prometheus_target" AND (attributes.deployment IS NOT NULL OR attributes.statefulset IS NOT NULL OR attributes.daemonset IS NOT NULL)
| STATS deployment_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_spec_replicas/gauge`)),
        deployment_avail = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/gauge`)),
        deployment_updated = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_deployment_status_replicas_updated/gauge`)),
        statefulset_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_replicas/gauge`)),
        statefulset_ready = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready/gauge`)),
        statefulset_updated = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_statefulset_status_replicas_updated/gauge`)),
        daemonset_desired = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled/gauge`)),
        daemonset_ready = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_number_ready/gauge`)),
        daemonset_updated = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_updated_number_scheduled/gauge`)),
        daemonset_misscheduled = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_daemonset_status_number_misscheduled/gauge`))
    BY kind = CASE(attributes.deployment IS NOT NULL, "Deployment", attributes.statefulset IS NOT NULL, "StatefulSet", "DaemonSet"),
       name = COALESCE(attributes.deployment, attributes.statefulset, attributes.daemonset)
| EVAL desired = COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(deployment_desired), TO_DOUBLE(statefulset_desired), TO_DOUBLE(daemonset_desired)),
       ready_or_available = COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(deployment_avail), TO_DOUBLE(statefulset_ready), TO_DOUBLE(daemonset_ready)),
       updated = COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(deployment_updated), TO_DOUBLE(statefulset_updated), TO_DOUBLE(daemonset_updated)),
       misscheduled = TO_DOUBLE(daemonset_misscheduled)
| KEEP kind, name, desired, ready_or_available, updated, misscheduled
| SORT kind ASC, name ASC
| LIMIT 100

embeddableConfig.description: Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets in the namespace with their latest desired, ready or available, and updated replicas (kube-state-metrics). Misscheduled applies to DaemonSets only. Empty when kube-state-metrics is not enabled.

query.esql:
TS metrics-gcp.gke.otel-default
| WHERE resource.attributes.gcp.resource_type IN ("k8s_container", "prometheus_target")
    AND (attributes.memory_type == "non-evictable" OR attributes.memory_type IS NULL)
| STATS mem_util = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/limit_utilization`)),
        cpu_used = SUM(RATE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/cpu/core_usage_time`)),
        mem_used = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/memory/used_bytes`)),
        restarts = SUM(INCREASE(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/restart_count`)),
        eph_used = SUM(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/used_bytes`)),
        eph_limit = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.kubernetes.io/container/ephemeral_storage/limit_bytes`)),
        phase_on = MAX(LAST_OVER_TIME(`metrics.prometheus.googleapis.com/kube_pod_status_phase/gauge`))
    BY pod = COALESCE(resource.attributes.pod_name, attributes.pod), resource.attributes.container_name, attributes.phase
| STATS memory_limit_util = MAX(mem_util),
        cpu_used_cores = SUM(cpu_used),
        memory_used_bytes = SUM(mem_used),
        restarts = SUM(restarts),
        ephemeral_used_bytes = SUM(eph_used),
        ephemeral_limit_bytes = SUM(CASE(eph_limit > 0, eph_limit, NULL)),
        phase = MAX(CASE(phase_on == 1, attributes.phase, NULL))
    BY pod
| EVAL restarts = ROUND(restarts), memory_used_gib = memory_used_bytes / 1073741824.0, ephemeral_used_gib = ephemeral_used_bytes / 1073741824.0, ephemeral_limit = COALESCE(CONCAT(TO_STRING(ROUND(ephemeral_limit_bytes / 1073741824.0, 2)), " GiB"), "No limit")
| SORT memory_limit_util DESC NULLS LAST
| LIMIT 100
| KEEP pod, memory_limit_util, phase, restarts, cpu_used_cores, memory_used_gib, ephemeral_used_gib, ephemeral_limit

embeddableConfig.description: Pods of the namespace, worst first by the highest container memory limit utilization (`container/memory/limit_utilization`). Phase comes from kube-state-metrics. Ephemeral storage limit sums the container limits that are set. Click a pod to open its detail.
